claim_md:
> Our model achieves 89% accuracy on held-out inspections and is intended to schedule maintenance across the existing fleet.

Methods as stated: We predict whether a pump faults at its next inspection from ten sensor readings plus the pump's load at the previous inspection.
The six most informative sensors were selected with an ANOVA F-test; inspections were randomly divided into 75% training and 25% test with a fixed random seed.

The 95% unpaired-bootstrap interval for the drop excludes zero on 3 of 3 seeds (seed 42 [+12.1, +19.7]; seed 43 [+10.8, +18.3]; seed 44 [+11.6, +19.6]); 750 rows scored by the claim, 750 after the change. Please report the score under a justification that every input is available at prediction time, or removal of the offending input, or justify the current protocol.
